messages:
lee: Hey — first day! trying to SSO into GitHub but Okta blocks login, says 'Device trust required'. I'm on a personal Mac, no MDM. Who do I ping for a temporary exception or quick way to push code?

people-ops: Welcome @lee :wave: You shouldn't need an exception long-term. Please open an IT ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk with request 'MDM exemption for new hire' and tag @it-support. Also share macOS version and whether you can enroll in Workspace One.

lee: thanks — macOS 13.6.1. I can't enroll because company enrollment page errors with 'device not eligible'.

it-support: Hi @lee — created ticket IT-8421 and assigned to onboarding. Can you paste the screenshot of the error?

it-support-bot: Ticket IT-8421 created by it-support. ETA: 24–48h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-8421

lee: (uploads screenshot) ```Enrollment failed: device not eligible for device management.```

devx: Often that means Corporate SSO requires Device Trust via MDM. Quick workaround: you can use a PAT + gh CLI to push until MDM is sorted. Example:
```
# create a token at https://github.com/settings/tokens (repo scope)
echo '<your-token>' | gh auth login --with-token
# then push as usual
git push origin main
```

jamal: Also you can connect to the office VPN (AnyConnect) and try SSO again — device attestation sometimes passes from the office network.

nina: Added you to 1Password, @lee — check your email for the invite. If you don't see it, reply here and I'll resend.

lee: tried VPN from home, same error. IT ticket says they'll escalate to security for a short-lived exception. Appreciate the PAT workaround.

security: FYI we approved a 48h emergency push exception for @lee. Internal note: rotate token after use, do NOT store token in dotfiles or commit history, and prioritize MDM enrollment.

lee: got it, thanks all. Any ETA for MDM enrollment / enablement?

it-support: MDM onboarding ETA 24–48h pending security approval and device logs. We'll DM you once enrollment is ready.

lee: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — will hold off on heavy pushes until enrolled and will rotate token after testing.
